lines: Beep beep beep!
The SKY cracked, {player}! Skies don't do that!
Ground control says it's fine. I'm ground control.
The sky's healed up. Mostly. Squint and you can see where.
The little ones think it was a party.
Beep beep beep!
{player}! Look up! Something blue is floating up there!
There's another by my boots.
Step on the pad and call the mothership. It goes up there!
Hello! Ground control to... um... you!
{player}: I'm {player}! Are you from space?
Sort of! I'm from Earth. I flew up and landed here!
Back home the sky is blue, not green.
{player}: Blue? That sounds weird.
Ha! I'll stay by the pad. Say hi any time.
Beep. Beep.
The portal's open! Is there a way to Earth with no rocket?
Look at the stars, {player}. I've been to a few.
Well... near a few.
Morning! Space porridge floats off the spoon!

rotate: Want to know what the big red button does?
Me too. I'm too scared to press it.
The mothership's gone round the town fourteen times today!
My helmet keeps my ears warm. And bugs out!
Sorry! More gravity here. I'm practising.
